mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 months signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not show a sustained 3-month decline or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation index crosses above its 12-month high, signaling rising inflation expectations, this often prompts the Fed to raise rates, which can depress equity valuations and result in negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL does not cross above its 12-month high or 20-day returns are not negative when it does.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in GDPC1 (demand) and PAYEMS (labor) above their 5-year averages indicate robust economic growth and strong labor market conditions, fostering optimism and positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 5-year avg and PAYEMS > 5-year avg in same month
failure_condition: GDPC1 and PAYEMS do not simultaneously exceed their 5-year averages or 60-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a sudden drop in FEDFUNDS below 2% signals unexpected easing, reducing policy tightness and potentially lifting equity valuations, driving positive 20-day returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not drop below 2.0% in a tightening regime or 20-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: Both GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) exceeding their 10-year averages simultaneously suggest balanced growth with low inflation, enhancing market confidence and positive 20-day returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 10-year avg and INDPRO > 10-year avg in same month
failure_condition: GDPC1 and INDPRO do not both exceed their 10-year averages or 20-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in UNRATE above 3.5% in a single month may signal labor market tightness, raising unemployment expectations and pressuring corporate profits, leading to negative 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not rise above 3.5% in a single month or 5-day returns are not negative.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE over 6 months indicates a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, which can drive positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not show a sustained 6-month decline or 20-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in GDPC1 below its 5-year moving average suggests weakening demand growth, prompting market concerns about overheating and negative 60-day returns.
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not fall below its 5-year moving average in late-cycle expansion or 60-day returns are not negative.
